digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program (observability, gates, migrations, skill discipline)
propositions: Bug provenance must be observable at creation (detected-by) and queryable via bug_trends metrics without requiring new user input.

Deterministic pre-LLM gates must prevent: raw git writes bypassing the store seam, unread config schema fields, unchecked wall-clock asserts in tests, incomplete AC checkboxes at close, and oversized bug-fix diffs lacking plan-review attestation.
Reconciler transport typing, declared field asymmetry property tests, and pagination deduplication into shared iterators must be enforced end-to-end.
Production shell logic (reconcile-bridge/canary workflows, probe harness, vote normalizer) must be migrated to Python per strangler-fig policy.
Code comments citing dead SHAs/run-ids/dates must be remediated to ticket citations with CI regression prevention.
Epic completion attestation was missing after initial closure; fix requires grandfathering pre-330c attestations and re-running completion verifier to generate signed attestation.
